source: football wourld cup in a 2026 mordern staidium to play football and a 3d screen so theres a lobby and people vote for a country and two countrys are chosen and than people choose what country they wanna play as and make sure it's not on base plate and it's in a staidiam

answers.ask: Is the lobby attached to the stadium as one map, or a separate place players teleport out of when the match starts?
answers.answer: Make the lobby attached to the modern 2026 stadium as one map, so players can vote and then go straight into the stadium match.

answers.ask: How does a match end - fixed timer, first to a score, or full-length halves?
answers.answer: Use a fixed short match timer for a simple playable game; the team with the most goals when time ends wins.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] shape — Q: Is the lobby attached to the stadium as one map, or a separate place players teleport out of when the match starts? A: Make the lobby attached to the modern 2026 stadium as one map, so players can vote and then go straight into the stadium match.
- [author] goal — Q: How does a match end - fixed timer, first to a score, or full-length halves? A: Use a fixed short match timer for a simple playable game; the team with the most goals when time ends wins.
- [agent_inferred] football code — Q: Which football field specification applies? A: Use soccer, as implied by the international country tournament and goal scoring.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a modern 2026-style international soccer stadium on integrated terrain with no visible baseplate. Centre the build on a rectangular grass soccer pitch with standard markings and two goal nets, surrounded by tiered stands and a stadium enclosure. Attach one enclosed voting lobby directly to the stadium as part of the same map. Put a large physical 3D country-voting screen in the lobby and connect the lobby to the match field through a clear stadium tunnel or concourse so players can walk straight into the arena.

## Genre
Sports is dominant because the map is a formal soccer stadium with team starts, field boundaries, and goal scoring.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, Zone (Bounded Field or Court), for the stadium field as the dominant space. The preset is Full Stadium, augmented with an attached voting-lobby zone and soccer field requirements.

## Config requirements
Use the visible parts of `trigger-bounds`, `startpoint-play`, and `trigger-scoring` for the soccer field, centre start, and two goals. Use `spectator-bleachers`, `barrier-perimeter`, and `spectator-zone` for the stadium. Use `social-hub` from the shared catalogue for the attached voting lobby and `building-interior` for its enclosed same-map space. Preserve the 3D voting screen and lobby-to-field tunnel as scene-specific geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` TriggerZone around the pitch, `startpoint-play` StartPoints at the centre and team reset positions, and exactly two `trigger-scoring` TriggerZones in the goal mouths. Place one free-text Tracker on the lobby's 3D voting screen with country-selection TriggerZones against it. Do not place Teleporters; lobby and stadium connect physically.

## Layout components
The stadium field is the dominant zone. A secondary attached lobby zone contains the voting screen and open gathering floor. A walkable concourse or tunnel joins it directly to the pitch. Tiered seating wraps the field, team areas sit beside it, and the stadium foundation meets authored ground rather than a baseplate.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish the soccer field, two goals, lobby footprint, and direct physical connection first, then dress the plan as a modern isometric stadium.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale so the pitch, seating, lobby screen, and connecting tunnel remain legible. The theme is a modern international soccer tournament stadium. Route `tiered` for stepped seating and `P3` for movement between the enclosed lobby and the open stadium field.
